data.why: The app is fully self-contained: it loads a fixed published model spec (model_specs/wu_zhou_tian_2022.yaml), a frozen control-search grid (model_specs/search_v0.yaml), and a claim registry (claims/registry.yaml) directly from the repo by path; there is no file-upload widget and nothing to seed.

goals: Reproduce the published model's four stable phenotype attractors (G1H, P1H, G2H, LE3G) and confirm their stability by eigenvalue check
Compile a temporary control that drives the model from a chosen starting phenotype to a desired target phenotype and verify it persists after washout
Compare candidate controls on cost (sparsity) versus robustness and inspect the Pareto-ranked alternatives
Build the full twelve-pair conditional phenotype reachability atlas under chosen constraints and objective
Inspect simulated state trajectories and time series for a compiled transition, and export the transition or atlas as JSON/CSV for downstream analysis
Review the methods and limitations tab to understand what the search does and does not establish about biological feasibility

review.summary: The tree describes the single-transition inverse-design workflow faithfully, from start/target selection through washout persistence, ranked alternatives and export, and its reproduction and limitations phases are well supported. Every screen I sampled shows what its node says. The reachability atlas, which the README treats as the main V0 result, is missing as a phase and has no task, and robustness is never shown. It should be filed after those fixes and a tidy-up of t2/t7.
